name: The Meditating Apsara
notes: A radiant celestial nymph who descended to Jambhudweepa's volcanic cliffs for deep meditation. During a cataclysmic flood and under the gaze of a red Asura planet, she united with the Narmada Man, giving him the celestial strength to conquer the wild lands. She later gave birth to a shimmering, Asura-tainted egg before levitating into the lunar light, leaving her mortal partner to dwell forever on the moon.
sources: Narmada Valley: The Primordial Gateway of Jambhudweepa
The Narmada Man: Primordial King of the Riverbones
